content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My fitness app closes rings right when I silently tell myself to finish. It’s like it hears me.
Rings close when the metric threshold is met. Did the prompts happen near step or heart-rate milestones, or at scheduled stand reminders?
Often near the stand reminder or during the last minutes of a walk.
Those are common closure points. Comparing a no-reminder hour to a normal hour can show whether the alignment remains without scheduled cues.
I’ll try an hour with reminders off.
A quick note of times and which ring closed should make patterns easier to review.
If it still aligns, I’ll note that too.
